mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM NOTICE
ORDER BY IS_PINNED DESC, NOTICE_ID DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( ADMIN_ID, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CONTENT, IS_PINNED, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{isPinned}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET NOTICE_TITLE = #{noticeTitle}, NOTICE_CONTENT = #{noticeContent}, IS_PINNED = #{isPinned}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID AS imageId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME AS imageOriginName, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, IMAGE_TYPE AS imageType, DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM NOTICE_IMAGE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER
